summary: Draw each agent's own mark, in one colour, wherever an app lists or picks a chat: the desktop's sidebar rows and Recents, the composer chip and the agent tabs, Cmd+P, Cmd+Shift+F, hub child and batch rows, kanban cards and the reviews linked-chat card; the Expo app's conversation rows; and the native Android browse rows. One data file (shared/agent-marks) feeds all three: the desktop and Expo read it directly, Android through vector drawables generated from it.

sharedBackendApi.reason: No contract change. src/shared/agent-marks.ts is a static table of drawing data read by the client that renders it; it adds no IPC channel, no wire field, no capability and no backend read. Every agent id it keys on (AGENT_PROVIDERS) already crosses the wire, and an id this build has no mark for falls back to initials, so an older or newer backend needs nothing.

storageDataMigration.reason: Presentation only. No table, column, settings key or stored format is added or read differently. The mark of a chat is derived at render time from the agentType the conversation already stores.

automated: npm run typecheck passed for both the main and renderer projects.

npx vitest run --maxWorkers=2 passed, including tests/unit/agent-marks.test.ts and tests/unit/android-agent-mark-drawables.test.ts, which keeps the checked-in vector drawables equal to the shared path data (regenerate with SB_UPDATE_FIXTURES=1).

apps/mobile: npx tsc --noEmit and the jest suite passed, including src/components/__tests__/AgentMark.test.tsx, which renders the OpenCode mark, takes the wire spelling of Claude and draws nothing for an agent with no mark.
apps/android: the Gradle unit tests passed, including AgentMarksTest, which checks that every generated drawable has a Kotlin mapping and that an unknown agent gets none.
The desktop screens are unchanged by this branch, so no screenshot baseline moved.

The Play store screenshots were regenerated from the Robolectric StoreScreenshotsTest, because 02-chats.png shows the browse chat list the marks are on. 03-running-chat.png, 04-approval.png and 05-diff.png moved too, in the chat header subtitle and the file-diff footer: those are screens this branch does not touch, so the committed shots had drifted from main and the rerun caught up with it. 01-connections.png and 06-reviews.png came out pixel for pixel the same and were left alone.

An adversarial review of the branch diff was run. Its findings were fixed: Android drew the Claude mark on a chat imported from Cursor (such a chat is stored as claude-code, and now keeps its text label), a row whose only supporting text was the agent name rendered an empty second line, and an agent with no mark left the titles of a mixed list in two columns.
notExercised: No mark was seen on a real iPhone or a real Android handset: the Expo app was exercised by jest and tsc only, and Android by its unit tests and the Robolectric render.

react-native-svg is a native module. The iOS app needs a new TestFlight or App Store binary before a phone can draw these marks; the fingerprint runtimeVersion keeps this OTA off older binaries, which keep the text chip. No iOS build was made here.
Mistral Vibe, Cline and GitHub Copilot have no account on this machine, so their marks were checked as data and as drawables, never on a real chat row.

The agent pickers are unchanged on both phones: Expo's NewSessionScreen and Android's new-session screen still name each agent in text. A picker names what you choose, so it keeps its words; only the lists of existing chats carry a mark.
